insights.one_liner: ADM is a US-owned global food, animal nutrition and agricultural processing group, with one English-friendly research internship in Wageningen.

culture.text: Describes itself as a global leader in human and animal nutrition and in agricultural origination and processing.
Its one open role here is a research internship in Wageningen.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor under the ADM name.
Its one open job here does not require Dutch.
Dutch entities include ADM Services B.V. and ADM Investor Services B.V., owned by US-based Archer-Daniels-Midland Company.

growth.text: Announced a joint venture with CJ CheilJedang to strengthen amino acid production and supply chains.
Invested $55.5M in a precision fermentation upgrade.
Expanded its regenerative flour initiative in the UK.

worth_knowing.text: Plans an 800,000-ton carbon removal credit offering from carbon capture and storage in Nebraska.
Published a report on its regenerative agriculture results, relevant if you care about sustainable food.
